prompt.en: Run your finger along a box where two faces meet. Is that line a face, an edge or a corner?
prompt.hi: Dabbe pe ungli wahan chalao jahan do faces milte hain. Woh line face hai, edge hai, ya corner?

challenges.hint: Faces are flat and corners are points; the line between two faces has its own name.

prompt.en: How many corners does a cube have?
prompt.hi: Ek cube ke kitne corners hote hain?

challenges.hint: Count the corners of the top face, then the bottom face.

prompt.en: A dice is a cube and a matchbox is a cuboid. Which one has more edges?
prompt.hi: Dice ek cube hai aur maachis ki dibbi ek cuboid. Kisme zyada edges hain?

challenges.hint: Count the edges around the top, around the bottom, and the standing ones.

prompt.en: I counted the edges of a cube and got 8. Did I count right?
prompt.hi: Maine cube ke edges gine aur 8 aaye. Kya maine sahi gina?

challenges.hint: Corners are points; edges are the lines between faces.

prompt.en: A paper pyramid has a square at the bottom and triangles on its sides that meet at the top. How many faces does it have?
prompt.hi: Ek kaagaz ka pyramid hai: neeche square, aur side mein triangles jo upar ek point pe milte hain. Iske kitne faces hain?

challenges.hint: One triangle stands on each side of the square.

prompt.en: How many corners does that square pyramid have?
prompt.hi: Us square pyramid ke kitne corners hain?

challenges.hint: Count the base corners, then look at the very top.

prompt.en: On a cube-shaped stage prop, three edges meet at one point. Is that point a face, an edge or a corner?
prompt.hi: Cube shape ke stage prop par teen edges ek point par milti hain. Woh point face, edge ya corner hai?

challenges.hint: Edges are lines; look at where they meet.

prompt.en: A photo of a closed cuboid parcel shows its top, front and right faces. How many faces are hidden?
prompt.hi: Ek band cuboid parcel ki photo mein top, front aur right faces dikh rahe hain. Kitne faces chhupe hue hain?

challenges.hint: Think of the faces opposite the ones you can see.

prompt.en: In a drawing of a cube-shaped storage box, 9 edges are visible. How many edges of the box are hidden?
prompt.hi: Cube shape ke storage box ki drawing mein 9 edges dikh rahi hain. Box ki kitni edges chhupi hui hain?

challenges.hint: Find the total edges of a cube before counting what remains.

prompt.en: Fold a paper twice to make a right-angle tester. Put it on a corner of your maths book. Does it fit exactly?
prompt.hi: Ek kaagaz ko do baar fold karke right-angle tester banao. Use apni maths book ke corner pe rakho. Kya woh bilkul fit hota hai?

challenges.hint: A paper folded twice makes a perfect square corner.

prompt.en: At 3 o'clock, do the two hands of a clock make a right angle?
prompt.hi: 3 baje ghadi ki dono suiyan kya right angle banati hain?

challenges.hint: One hand points straight up to 12 and one points across to 3.

prompt.en: Which time has the clock hands making a right angle: 6 o'clock or 9 o'clock?
prompt.hi: Kis time pe ghadi ki suiyan right angle banati hain: 6 baje ya 9 baje?

challenges.hint: Compare the opening between the hands with a square corner.

prompt.en: You tie a pencil to a 5 cm string and turn it around a pin, keeping the string tight. How far from the pin is every point on the circle?
prompt.hi: Tumne pencil ko 5 cm ki string se baandha aur string tight rakhkar pin ke chaaron taraf ghumaya. Circle ka har point pin se kitni door hai?

challenges.hint: The tight string is the distance from the pin to the pencil.

prompt.en: On a kabaddi court, a folded-paper square corner fits exactly where two painted lines meet. What kind of angle do the lines make?
prompt.hi: Kabaddi court par do painted lines jahaan milti hain, wahaan folded paper ka square corner bilkul fit hota hai. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?

challenges.hint: Compare the opening between the lines with the tester’s corner.

prompt.en: A square noticeboard is hung tilted like a diamond. A folded-paper right-angle tester still fits one corner exactly. Does tilting change that corner’s angle: yes or no?
prompt.hi: Square noticeboard ko diamond ki tarah tedha latkaya gaya hai. Folded-paper right-angle tester ab bhi uske ek corner par bilkul fit hota hai. Kya tedha latkane se corner ka angle badalta hai—haan ya nahin?

challenges.hint: Turning the whole board does not alter its corners.

prompt.en: On a game map, angle A has 12 cm arms and opens less than a right angle. Angle B has 2 cm arms and opens more than a right angle. Which is bigger, A or B?
prompt.hi: Game map mein angle A ki arms 12 cm hain aur woh right angle se kam khulta hai. Angle B ki arms 2 cm hain aur woh right angle se zyada khulta hai. Kaunsa bada hai, A ya B?

challenges.hint: A right angle helps you compare both openings.

prompt.en: Meera draws a circle using a tight 6 cm string tied to a fixed pin. Three chalk marks are 6 cm, 7 cm and 6 cm from the pin. Which distance belongs to a mark NOT on her circle?
prompt.hi: Meera fixed pin se bandhi 6 cm ki tani hui string se circle banati hai. Teen chalk marks pin se 6 cm, 7 cm aur 6 cm door hain. Kaunsi doori wala mark us circle par NAHIN hai?

challenges.hint: Every point on this circle is equally far from the pin.

prompt.en: On a square grid, a rectangle is 4 squares long and 2 squares tall. How many small squares are inside it?
prompt.hi: Square grid pe ek rectangle 4 squares lamba aur 2 squares ooncha hai. Uske andar kitne chhote squares hain?

challenges.hint: There are 2 rows with 4 squares in each.

prompt.en: Copy a T shape: 3 squares across the top and 2 squares going down from the middle square. How many squares are there in all?
prompt.hi: Ek T shape copy karo: upar 3 squares aur beech wale square se neeche 2 squares. Total kitne squares hain?

challenges.hint: Add the top row and the squares going down.

prompt.en: Riya wanted a line 3 units long on a dot grid, so she joined 3 dots. Is her line 3 units long?
prompt.hi: Riya ko dot grid pe 3 unit lambi line chahiye thi, isliye usne 3 dots joda. Kya uski line 3 unit lambi hai?

challenges.hint: Count the hops from dot to dot.

prompt.en: A courtyard floor is 5 tiles long and 4 tiles wide. All the tiles along the border are red and the ones inside are white. How many white tiles are there?
prompt.hi: Ek aangan ka farsh 5 tiles lamba aur 4 tiles chauda hai. Kinare ki saari tiles red hain aur andar wali white. Kitni white tiles hain?

challenges.hint: Remove one tile from each end of the length and of the width.

prompt.en: On a square grid, line A goes along one side of a small square. Line B goes slanting from one corner to the opposite corner of the same square. Are they the same length?
prompt.hi: Square grid pe line A ek chhote square ki ek side ke saath jaati hai. Line B usi square ke ek corner se saamne wale corner tak tirchi jaati hai. Kya dono ki lambai barabar hai?

challenges.hint: Measure both with the same paper strip.

prompt.en: A drum shaped like a cylinder stands on the floor. Guess its front view: a circle, a rectangle, or a triangle?
prompt.hi: Cylinder jaisa ek dhol zameen pe khada hai. Guess karo, saamne se kaisa dikhega: circle, rectangle, ya triangle?

challenges.hint: From the front you see its height and its width.

prompt.en: I said the top view of a gas cylinder standing up is a rectangle. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Maine kaha khade gas cylinder ka top view rectangle hai. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Look straight down on its round top.

prompt.en: An object looks like a triangle from the front and a circle from the top. Which is it: a cone, a cylinder, or a cube?
prompt.hi: Ek cheez saamne se triangle aur upar se circle jaisi dikhti hai. Woh kya hai: cone, cylinder, ya cube?

challenges.hint: A cylinder looks like a rectangle from the front.

prompt.en: Asked for the top view of a matchbox lying on a table, Mini drew a box with its top and two sides showing. Is that the top view?
prompt.hi: Mini se table pe padi maachis ki dibbi ka top view banane ko kaha, toh usne ek dabba banaya jisme upar aur do sides dikh rahi hain. Kya yeh top view hai?

challenges.hint: A view is a flat outline of only the face towards you.

prompt.en: Two equal cube-shaped parcels sit in a row, one directly behind the other. From the front, would you see one square or two squares side by side?
prompt.hi: Do barabar cube-shaped parcels rakhe hain, ek bilkul doosre ke peeche. Saamne se dekhne par ek square dikhega ya saath-saath do squares?

challenges.hint: In a front view, objects directly behind others can be hidden.

prompt.en: A package looks square from the top. Its front and side views are both rectangles taller than they are wide. Which could it be: a cube, an upright square-based carton, or an upright cylindrical tin?
prompt.hi: Ek package upar se square dikhta hai. Saamne aur side se dono views aise rectangles hain jo chaudai se zyada oonche hain. Yeh kya ho sakta hai: cube, seedha rakha square-base carton, ya seedha cylindrical tin?

challenges.hint: Check the top view first, then compare height with width.

prompt.en: Four equal square coasters cover four places in a 2-by-2 arrangement. Two more coasters are stacked on one corner place. How many square places appear in the top view?
prompt.hi: Chaar barabar square coasters 2-by-2 arrangement mein rakhe hain. Ek corner wali jagah par do aur coasters stack kiye gaye hain. Top view mein kitni square jagah dikhegi?

challenges.hint: A top view shows positions, not the number in each stack.

prompt.en: At a school display, two equal boxes stand side by side. Another box is stacked on the left one. From the front, which column looks taller: left or right?
prompt.hi: School display mein do barabar boxes saath-saath rakhe hain. Left box par ek aur box rakha hai. Saamne se kaunsa column zyada uncha dikhega: left ya right?

challenges.hint: A front view shows the height at each side-by-side position.

prompt.en: On a playground map, the slide is at B3. You stand at A3. How many steps to the right do you go to reach the slide?
prompt.hi: Playground ke map pe slide B3 pe hai. Tum A3 pe khade ho. Slide tak pahunchne ke liye kitne step right jaoge?

challenges.hint: A and B are next to each other.

prompt.en: From A1: path P is '2 steps right, then 3 steps up'. Path Q is '3 steps right, then 2 steps up'. Do they reach the same square?
prompt.hi: A1 se: rasta P hai '2 step right, phir 3 step upar'. Rasta Q hai '3 step right, phir 2 step upar'. Kya dono ek hi square pe pahunchte hain?

challenges.hint: Work out each path separately, one step at a time.

prompt.en: To go from A1 to A4, Tara counts 'A1 is one, A2 is two, A3 is three, A4 is four' and says it is 4 steps up. Is she right?
prompt.hi: A1 se A4 jaane ke liye Tara ginti hai 'A1 ek, A2 do, A3 teen, A4 chaar' aur kehti hai 4 step upar. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: A step is a move to a new square.

prompt.en: On a map, a boy walks down the page, towards you. He turns to HIS left. Does he go towards the left side or the right side of the page?
prompt.hi: Map pe ek ladka page pe neeche ki taraf, tumhari taraf chal raha hai. Woh APNE left mudta hai. Woh page ki left side jaayega ya right side?

challenges.hint: Use his viewpoint, not yours as you look at the map.

prompt.en: 7 children want to dance in pairs. Will anyone be left without a partner?
prompt.hi: 7 bachche jodi mein dance karna chahte hain. Kya koi bina partner ke reh jaayega?

challenges.hint: Make pairs: 2, 4, 6, and then?

prompt.en: Is 34 odd or even?
prompt.hi: 34 odd hai ya even?

challenges.hint: Only the ones digit decides.

prompt.en: Is 129 odd or even?
prompt.hi: 129 odd hai ya even?

challenges.hint: Look only at the last digit.

prompt.en: Which of these is even: 43 or 34?
prompt.hi: Inmein se even kaunsa hai: 43 ya 34?

challenges.hint: What is the ones digit in each?

prompt.en: Try odd + odd again with new numbers: 7 + 9. Is the answer odd or even?
prompt.hi: Naye numbers ke saath odd + odd phir se try karo: 7 + 9. Answer odd hai ya even?

challenges.hint: The two leftovers can pair with each other.

prompt.en: I say 70 is odd because 7 is odd. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Main kehta hoon 70 odd hai kyunki 7 odd hai. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: The 7 here means 7 tens, and tens always pair up.

prompt.en: In one cricket over of 6 balls, Rohit scored on every ball, and every ball was a 1 or a 3. Could his total for the over be 13?
prompt.hi: Ek over ki 6 balls mein Rohit ne har ball pe run banaye, aur har ball pe 1 ya 3 run. Kya poore over ka total 13 ho sakta hai?

challenges.hint: Two odd numbers make an even number; think of 3 such pairs of balls.

prompt.en: A school has 13 badminton rackets. If the rackets are packed in pairs, will one racket be left over? Answer yes or no.
prompt.hi: School mein 13 badminton rackets hain. Agar rackets jodiyon mein pack karein, toh kya ek racket bach jaayega? Haan ya nahin?

challenges.hint: A complete pair uses two rackets.

prompt.en: A school library has 142 books on one shelf. Without pairing every book, is 142 odd or even?
prompt.hi: School library ki ek shelf par 142 books hain. Har book ki jodi banaye bina batao: 142 odd hai ya even?

challenges.hint: Use the ones digit, not the hundreds digit.

prompt.en: At a school chess event, 47 players arrive. Games need two players each. After making as many games as possible, how many players are left without a game?
prompt.hi: School chess event mein 47 players aaye hain. Har game mein do players chahiye. Jitne games ban sakte hain banane ke baad, kitne players bina game ke bachenge?

challenges.hint: Make pairs until fewer than two players remain.

prompt.en: In two cricket matches, Meera scores an odd number of runs each time. Without knowing her scores, will their sum be odd or even?
prompt.hi: Do cricket matches mein Meera ne har baar odd number of runs banaye. Scores jaane bina batao: dono scores ka total odd hoga ya even?

challenges.hint: Think about what happens to the two leftovers together.

prompt.en: 2, 5, 8, 11, ___. What comes next?
prompt.hi: 2, 5, 8, 11, ___. Aage kya aayega?

challenges.hint: Every step adds 3.

prompt.en: 50, 45, 40, 35, ___. What comes next?
prompt.hi: 50, 45, 40, 35, ___. Aage kya aayega?

challenges.hint: Each step takes away 5.

prompt.en: Matchstick triangles in a row: 1 triangle needs 3 sticks, 2 joined triangles need 5, 3 joined triangles need 7. Say the rule. How many sticks for 4 triangles?
prompt.hi: Maachis ki teeliyon se line mein triangles: 1 triangle mein 3 teeli, 2 jude triangles mein 5, 3 jude triangles mein 7. Rule batao. 4 triangles ke liye kitni teeliyan?

challenges.hint: A new triangle shares one stick, so it needs only 2 more.

prompt.en: Pinki saves ₹5 on day 1, ₹10 on day 2, ₹15 on day 3, and each day she saves ₹5 more than the day before. How much will she save on day 6?
prompt.hi: Pinki pehle din ₹5 bachaati hai, doosre din ₹10, teesre din ₹15, aur har din pichhle din se ₹5 zyada. Chhathe din woh kitne bachayegi?

challenges.hint: Keep adding ₹5 for each new day.

prompt.en: On a calendar, the dates in one column go 3, 10, 17, ___. What comes next?
prompt.hi: Calendar ke ek column mein tareekhein hain 3, 10, 17, ___. Aage kya aayega?

challenges.hint: Each date in a column is one week after the one above.

prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! 64, 60, 56, ___?

challenges.hint: It goes down by 4.

prompt.en: A school canteen sells fruit cups for ₹18, ₹25 and ₹32 on three days. If the amount rises by the same number each day, what is the amount on day 4?
prompt.hi: School canteen ne teen din ₹18, ₹25 aur ₹32 ke fruit cups beche. Agar amount har din utna hi badhe, toh day 4 par kitna hoga?

challenges.hint: Check that the next rise is the same.

prompt.en: A game shows energy points of 94, 86 and 78 after three rounds. If the points keep falling by the same amount, what will the display show after round 4?
prompt.hi: Ek game mein teen rounds ke baad energy points 94, 86 aur 78 dikhte hain. Agar points har round utne hi ghatein, toh round 4 ke baad kya dikhega?

challenges.hint: Check whether the next loss matches.

prompt.en: Meera puts ₹125, ₹175 and ₹225 into her savings box in weeks 1, 2 and 3. She increases the amount by the same number each week. How much does she put in during week 6?
prompt.hi: Meera weeks 1, 2 aur 3 mein apne savings box mein ₹125, ₹175 aur ₹225 daalti hai. Har week amount utna hi badhati hai. Week 6 mein kitna daalegi?

challenges.hint: The same increase happens at every step through week 6.

prompt.en: A cricket practice counter shows 140, 137, 131, 122, 110. The number taken away grows regularly. What number comes next?
prompt.hi: Cricket practice ka counter 140, 137, 131, 122, 110 dikhata hai. Har baar ghataayi jaane wali sankhya ek regular pattern mein badhti hai. Aage kaunsa number aayega?

challenges.hint: Look for a pattern in those numbers taken away.

prompt.en: At a school exhibition, a growing tile design uses 5 tiles in stage 1, 8 in stage 2 and 11 in stage 3. The same number of tiles is added at each stage. How many tiles are in stage 7?
prompt.hi: School exhibition mein badhte tile design ke stage 1 mein 5 tiles, stage 2 mein 8 aur stage 3 mein 11 hain. Har stage mein utne hi tiles judte hain. Stage 7 mein kitne tiles honge?

challenges.hint: Use that rule for every stage after stage 3.

prompt.en: Write in numbers: two thousand three hundred forty-five.
prompt.hi: Numbers mein likho: do hazaar teen sau paintalees.

challenges.hint: Put one digit in each place: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones.

prompt.en: Write in numbers: four thousand fifty.
prompt.hi: Numbers mein likho: chaar hazaar pachaas.

challenges.hint: There are no hundreds, so that place needs a 0.

prompt.en: Three thousand five hundred, and three thousand five tens. Are they the same number? Write both.
prompt.hi: Teen hazaar paanch sau, aur teen hazaar paanch dahaai. Kya dono same number hain? Dono likho.

challenges.hint: Five hundreds goes in the hundreds place; five tens goes in the tens place.

prompt.en: Someone wrote 'five thousand twenty' as 500020. Is that right?
prompt.hi: Kisi ne 'paanch hazaar bees' ko 500020 likha. Kya yeh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Fill the 4 places: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones.

prompt.en: I have 2 thousand-cubes, 0 hundred-flats, 6 ten-rods and 4 single cubes. What number is that? Say it in words.
prompt.hi: Mere paas 2 thousand-cubes, 0 hundred-flats, 6 ten-rods aur 4 single cubes hain. Yeh kaunsa number hai? Shabdon mein bolo.

challenges.hint: Write one digit for each kind of block, with 0 for none.

prompt.en: A school buys notebooks: 4 big cartons of 1000, 7 packets of 100, and 9 loose notebooks. How many notebooks in all?
prompt.hi: Ek school notebooks khareedta hai: 1000-1000 ke 4 bade carton, 100-100 ke 7 packet, aur 9 khuli notebooks. Kul kitni notebooks?

challenges.hint: Thousands 4, hundreds 7, tens 0, ones 9.

prompt.en: Quick! What is the biggest 4-digit number?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! Sabse bada 4-digit number kaunsa hai?

challenges.hint: Put the biggest digit in every place.

prompt.en: A cycling event recorded 6,352 kilometres in total. How many hundreds does this number have in its hundreds place?
prompt.hi: Cycling event mein total 6,352 kilometre record hue. Is number ke hundreds place par kitne hundreds hain?

challenges.hint: Count places from the right: ones, tens, then hundreds.

prompt.en: A metro display says the station is 'eight thousand six hundred fourteen' metres from the depot. Write the distance in numerals.
prompt.hi: Metro display par depot se station ki doori 'aath hazaar chhah sau chaudah' metre likhi hai. Doori numerals mein likho.

challenges.hint: Give each place—thousands, hundreds, tens, ones—one digit.

prompt.en: A game score is 3,476. One extra hundred points is awarded. What is the new score?
prompt.hi: Game ka score 3,476 hai. Ek extra hundred points milte hain. Naya score kya hoga?

challenges.hint: Increase the hundreds digit; check whether any carrying is needed.

prompt.en: Which is bigger: 4520 or 3980?
prompt.hi: Kaun bada hai: 4520 ya 3980?

challenges.hint: A difference in thousands settles the comparison.

prompt.en: I said 2709 is bigger than 2790 because 9 is bigger than 0 at the end. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Maine kaha 2709, 2790 se bada hai kyunki aakhir mein 9, 0 se bada hai. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Thousands same, hundreds same; check the tens.

prompt.en: On a number line from 4000 to 5000, which is closer to 5000: 4900 or 4100?
prompt.hi: 4000 se 5000 tak ki number line pe kaun 5000 ke zyada paas hai: 4900 ya 4100?

challenges.hint: How far is each from 5000?

prompt.en: Which is bigger: 999 or 1000?
prompt.hi: Kaun bada hai: 999 ya 1000?

challenges.hint: A new place appears when the hundreds are full.

prompt.en: Quick! What is the smallest 4-digit number?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! Sabse chhota 4-digit number kaunsa hai?

challenges.hint: Choose the smallest possible digit at each place, starting left.

prompt.en: Two school teams collected 4,672 and 4,627 plastic bottles for recycling. Which team collected more: the 4,672 team or the 4,627 team?
prompt.hi: School ki do teams ne recycling ke liye 4,672 aur 4,627 plastic bottles jama ki. Kis team ne zyada jama ki: 4,672 wali ya 4,627 wali?

challenges.hint: If the first digits match, move one place to the right.

prompt.en: A game leaderboard shows scores of 3,408, 3,480 and 3,840. Which score comes in the middle when they are ordered from smallest to biggest?
prompt.hi: Game leaderboard par scores 3,408, 3,480 aur 3,840 hain. Inhe chhote se bade order mein rakho toh beech mein kaunsa score aayega?

challenges.hint: Compare hundreds, then tens when needed.

prompt.en: A number line has equally spaced marks labelled 4,000, 4,200, 4,400, blank, 4,800 and 5,000. What number belongs at the blank mark?
prompt.hi: Ek number line par barabar doori wale marks 4,000, 4,200, 4,400, khaali mark, 4,800 aur 5,000 hain. Khaali mark par kaunsa number aayega?

challenges.hint: Equal spacing means adding the same amount each time.

prompt.en: A roti is cut into 4 equal pieces. What do we call one piece?
prompt.hi: Ek roti ke 4 barabar tukde kiye. Ek tukde ko kya kehte hain?

challenges.hint: One piece out of 4 equal pieces.

prompt.en: What is half of 10 laddoos?
prompt.hi: 10 laddoo ka aadha kitna hai?

challenges.hint: Share 10 into 2 equal groups.

prompt.en: Share 12 bananas equally among 3 friends. What is 1/3 of 12?
prompt.hi: 12 kele 3 doston mein barabar baanto. 12 ka 1/3 kitna hai?

challenges.hint: Make 3 equal groups from 12.

prompt.en: A chocolate has 4 equal pieces and I ate 1. I say I ate 1/3 because 3 pieces are left. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Ek chocolate mein 4 barabar tukde hain aur maine 1 khaaya. Main kehta hoon maine 1/3 khaaya kyunki 3 tukde bache. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: The bottom number counts all the parts of the whole, not the ones left.

prompt.en: What is 1/4 of 20 marbles?
prompt.hi: 20 kanchon ka 1/4 kitna hai?

challenges.hint: Share 20 into 4 equal groups.

prompt.en: Quick! Which is more: 1/2 of a pizza or 1/4 of the same pizza?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! Kya zyada hai: ek pizza ka 1/2 ya usi pizza ka 1/4?

challenges.hint: Which cut makes bigger pieces?

prompt.en: For a school display, a square poster is divided into 4 equal squares. Two squares are painted blue. What fraction of the poster is blue?
prompt.hi: School display ke liye ek square poster ko 4 barabar squares mein baanta gaya. Do squares blue paint kiye. Poster ka kitna hissa blue hai?

challenges.hint: Write painted squares over all the equal squares.

prompt.en: A music club has 9 drumsticks. One-third are kept as spares. How many drumsticks are spares?
prompt.hi: Music club ke paas 9 drumsticks hain. Unka ek-tihaai hissa spare rakha hai. Kitni drumsticks spare hain?

challenges.hint: One-third means taking one of those equal groups.

prompt.en: Two same-sized rectangular school flags each have 4 coloured sections. Flag A has 4 equal sections; Flag B has one wide section and three narrow ones. On which flag is one section definitely one-quarter: A or B?
prompt.hi: Do ek-size ke rectangular school flags mein 4-4 coloured sections hain. Flag A ke sections barabar hain; Flag B mein ek chauda aur teen patle hain. Kis flag ka ek section pakka one-quarter hai: A ya B?

challenges.hint: Does counting sections alone tell you each section’s fraction?

prompt.en: Half a kilo of tomatoes is how many grams?
prompt.hi: Aadha kilo tamatar kitne gram hote hain?

challenges.hint: 1 kg is 1000 g; half means 2 equal parts.

prompt.en: Paav kilo dhaniya, a quarter kilo of coriander, is how many grams?
prompt.hi: Paav kilo dhaniya, yaani ek-chauthaai kilo, kitne gram hai?

challenges.hint: A quarter means 1000 g shared into 4 equal parts.

prompt.en: Half a metre of ribbon is how many centimetres?
prompt.hi: Aadha metre ribbon kitne centimetre hai?

challenges.hint: 1 m is 100 cm; take half of it.

prompt.en: Three-quarter litre of milk is how many ml?
prompt.hi: Teen-chauthaai litre doodh kitne ml hai?

challenges.hint: A quarter litre is 250 ml; take three of them.

prompt.en: I said half a kilo of onions is 50 g. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Maine kaha aadha kilo pyaaz 50 g hai. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Half of 1000, not half of 100.

prompt.en: Three-quarter metre of cloth is how many cm?
prompt.hi: Teen-chauthaai metre kapda kitne cm hai?

challenges.hint: A quarter metre is 25 cm; take three of them.

prompt.en: Quick! How many 250 g packets make 1 kg?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! 250 g ke kitne packet milkar 1 kg bante hain?

prompt.en: A recipe needs a quarter litre of coconut milk. How many millilitres is that? (1 litre = 1000 ml.)
prompt.hi: Ek recipe mein paav litre coconut milk chahiye. Yeh kitne millilitre honge? (1 litre = 1000 ml.)

challenges.hint: A quarter means divide the whole amount into four equal parts.

prompt.en: For a school event, Meera needs half a kilogram of clay. How many grams of clay does she need? (1 kg = 1000 g.)
prompt.hi: School event ke liye Meera ko aadha kilogram clay chahiye. Use kitne gram clay chahiye? (1 kg = 1000 g.)

challenges.hint: Divide the grams in one kilogram into two equal parts.

prompt.en: A one-litre water bottle has a three-quarter mark. How many millilitres does the bottle hold when water reaches that mark? (1 litre = 1000 ml.)
prompt.hi: Ek litre ki water bottle par three-quarter ka mark hai. Paani us mark tak ho toh bottle mein kitne millilitre paani hai? (1 litre = 1000 ml.)

challenges.hint: Find one quarter first, then take three such parts.

prompt.en: A three-quarter metre strip of reflective tape is needed for a cycle. Aarav has a 70 cm strip. How many more centimetres does he need? (1 metre = 100 cm.)
prompt.hi: Cycle ke liye three-quarter metre reflective tape chahiye. Aarav ke paas 70 cm tape hai. Use aur kitne centimetre chahiye? (1 metre = 100 cm.)

challenges.hint: Find one quarter of a metre, then three quarters.

prompt.en: For a school stall, Riya mixes half a kilogram of roasted chana with a quarter kilogram of peanuts and 100 g of raisins. What is the total weight? (1 kg = 1000 g.)
prompt.hi: School stall ke liye Riya aadha kilogram roasted chana, paav kilogram moongphali aur 100 g kishmish milati hai. Kul wazan kitne gram hai? (1 kg = 1000 g.)

challenges.hint: Find the half-kilo and quarter-kilo amounts before adding.

prompt.en: A pencil starts at 0 on a ruler and ends at 12. How long is it?
prompt.hi: Ek pencil ruler pe 0 se shuru hoti hai aur 12 pe khatam. Woh kitni lambi hai?

challenges.hint: From 0, the end mark tells the length.

prompt.en: How many centimetres make 1 metre?
prompt.hi: Kitne centimetre milkar 1 metre bante hain?

challenges.hint: Think of how a metre scale is divided into centimetres.

prompt.en: 2 m is how many cm?
prompt.hi: 2 m kitne cm hain?

challenges.hint: Each metre is 100 cm.

prompt.en: Which is longer: 1 m or 90 cm?
prompt.hi: Kaun lamba hai: 1 m ya 90 cm?

challenges.hint: Change both to cm.

prompt.en: 3 m 40 cm is how many cm?
prompt.hi: 3 m 40 cm kitne cm hain?

challenges.hint: 3 m is 300 cm; add the 40 cm.

prompt.en: I wrote 1 m 5 cm = 15 cm. Is that right?
prompt.hi: Maine likha 1 m 5 cm = 15 cm. Kya yeh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: 1 m is 100 cm; then add 5 cm.

prompt.en: To make a 2 m long rangoli border, Asha has ribbons that are 50 cm each. How many ribbons does she need?
prompt.hi: 2 m lambi rangoli border banane ke liye Asha ke paas 50-50 cm ke ribbon hain. Use kitne ribbon chahiye?

challenges.hint: 2 m is 200 cm; count up in 50s.

prompt.en: Quick! Half a metre is how many cm?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! Aadha metre kitne cm hai?

challenges.hint: Half of 100.

prompt.en: A school ID card is placed with its left edge at the 0 cm mark of a ruler. Its right edge reaches the 9 cm mark. How long is the card?
prompt.hi: School ID card ka left edge ruler ke 0 cm mark par hai. Right edge 9 cm mark tak pahunchta hai. Card kitna lamba hai?

challenges.hint: When measuring from zero, read the mark at the other edge.

prompt.en: Meera has 1 m of ribbon and buys 20 cm more. What is the total length in centimetres?
prompt.hi: Meera ke paas 1 m ribbon hai aur woh 20 cm aur khareedti hai. Kul lambai centimetres mein kitni hai?

challenges.hint: First change the metre into centimetres.

prompt.en: The zero end of a ruler is broken. A cricket bat grip starts at the 6 cm mark and ends at the 23 cm mark. How long is the grip?
prompt.hi: Ruler ka zero wala hissa toot gaya hai. Cricket bat ka grip 6 cm mark se 23 cm mark tak hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?

challenges.hint: Find the distance between the two ruler marks.

prompt.en: For a school event, one rope is 4 m 35 cm long and another is 390 cm long. Which is longer: the first rope or the second rope?
prompt.hi: School event ke liye ek rope 4 m 35 cm lambi hai aur doosri 390 cm. Kaunsi zyada lambi hai: pehli rope ya doosri rope?

challenges.hint: Change the mixed length into centimetres before comparing.

prompt.en: A triangle has sides 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm. What is the distance around it?
prompt.hi: Ek triangle ki sides 3 cm, 4 cm aur 5 cm hain. Uske chaaron taraf ki doori kitni hai?

challenges.hint: Add all three sides.

prompt.en: A rectangular table is 2 m long and 1 m wide. What is the distance around it?
prompt.hi: Ek rectangle table 2 m lambi aur 1 m chaudi hai. Uske chaaron taraf ki doori kitni hai?

challenges.hint: Two long sides and two short sides.

prompt.en: A square handkerchief has sides of 20 cm. How much lace is needed for its edge?
prompt.hi: Ek square rumaal ki har side 20 cm hai. Uske kinaare ke liye kitni lace chahiye?

challenges.hint: All 4 sides are 20 cm.

prompt.en: A rectangular garden is 10 m long and 6 m wide. How much fencing is needed to go all around it?
prompt.hi: Ek rectangle bageecha 10 m lamba aur 6 m chauda hai. Chaaron taraf kitni baad (fencing) chahiye?

challenges.hint: Two sides of 10 m and two sides of 6 m.

prompt.en: A tablecloth is 120 cm long and 80 cm wide. I said the lace needed is 120 + 80 = 200 cm. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Ek tablecloth 120 cm lamba aur 80 cm chauda hai. Maine kaha lace chahiye 120 + 80 = 200 cm. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Two sides are missing.

prompt.en: A square park has sides of 50 m. Ramu walks around it 2 times. How far does he walk?
prompt.hi: Ek square park ki har side 50 m hai. Ramu uske 2 chakkar lagata hai. Woh kitna chalta hai?

challenges.hint: One round is 4 sides of 50 m.

prompt.en: On a grid, a rectangle is 4 units long and 3 units tall. Meena counted the squares touching the edge, got 10, and said the distance around is 10 units. Is she right?
prompt.hi: Grid pe ek rectangle 4 units lamba aur 3 units ooncha hai. Meena ne kinaare ko chhoone wale squares gine, 10 aaye, aur boli chaaron taraf ki doori 10 units hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Count the unit edges on the boundary; a corner square gives two.

prompt.en: A four-sided school notice board has edges of 8 cm, 5 cm, 7 cm and 6 cm. How much tape is needed to cover its edge once?
prompt.hi: School notice board ki chaar sides 8 cm, 5 cm, 7 cm aur 6 cm hain. Uske poore kinare par ek baar tape lagane ke liye kitni tape chahiye?

challenges.hint: Include every edge once.

prompt.en: A square rangoli has each side 15 cm long. How long is the line around its edge?
prompt.hi: Ek square rangoli ki har side 15 cm hai. Uske poore kinare ki line kitni lambi hogi?

challenges.hint: Use the length of each edge.

prompt.en: A school event banner has five edges measuring 40 cm, 25 cm, 30 cm, 25 cm and 40 cm. Ribbon goes around it twice. How much ribbon is needed?
prompt.hi: School event ke banner ki paanch sides 40 cm, 25 cm, 30 cm, 25 cm aur 40 cm hain. Ribbon do baar poore kinare par lagegi. Kitni ribbon chahiye?

challenges.hint: First add every edge; then count both rounds.

prompt.en: A rectangular kabaddi practice area is 18 m long and 12 m wide. Players run around its boundary three times. How far do they run?
prompt.hi: Kabaddi practice area 18 m lamba aur 12 m chauda rectangle hai. Players uske kinare ke teen chakkar lagate hain. Woh kitni door daudte hain?

challenges.hint: Find one round before counting all three.

prompt.en: A 5 m by 4 m rectangular stall needs rope along its edge, not a mat inside. Which amount should organisers use: 18 m of rope or 20 square metres of mat?
prompt.hi: Ek rectangular stall 5 m lamba aur 4 m chauda hai. Organisers ko kinare par rassi lagani hai, andar mat nahi bichhani. Kaunsi matra sahi hai: 18 m rassi ya 20 square metre mat?

challenges.hint: Choose a length, not a measure of space inside.

prompt.hi: Chalo jodo: 2345 aur 1432 milake kitna hua?

challenges.hint: Add ones, then tens, then hundreds, then thousands.

prompt.hi: Ab yeh jodo: 1478 + 2356 kitna hoga? Carry ka dhyaan rakhna.

challenges.hint: 8 + 6 = 14: write 4, carry 1 ten.

prompt.en: Subtract: 5642 − 2318 = ?
prompt.hi: Ab ghatao: 5642 mein se 2318 nikaalo, kitna bacha?

challenges.hint: Borrow 1 ten: 12 − 8 = 4, and 4 tens become 3 tens.

prompt.en: For 503 − 278, one child got 225 and another got 375. Which is right?
prompt.hi: 503 − 278 mein ek bachche ka answer 225 aaya aur doosre ka 375. Kaun sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Add each suggested result to 278; the total should be 503.

prompt.en: For a trip, the train ticket costs ₹1250 and the bus ticket costs ₹375. What is the total?
prompt.hi: Ek trip ke liye train ticket ₹1250 ka hai aur bus ticket ₹375 ka. Total kitna hua?

challenges.hint: Line up the ones: 0 and 5.

prompt.en: For 4003 − 1256, I wrote 3747. Is that right?
prompt.hi: 4003 − 1256 ke liye maine 3747 likha. Kya yeh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Borrowing across zeros changes the thousands digit too.

prompt.en: Daisy's family travelled 1240 km by train and then 86 km by car to reach Mawlynnong. They came back the same way. How many km did they travel in all?
prompt.hi: Daisy ka parivaar Mawlynnong pahunchne ke liye 1240 km train se aur phir 86 km car se gaya. Wapas bhi usi raaste aaye. Kul kitne km safar kiya?

challenges.hint: One way is 1240 + 86; the trip back is the same again.

prompt.en: I added 2508 + 64 by writing the 64 under the 25. I got 8908. Is that right?
prompt.hi: Maine 2508 + 64 ko jodte waqt 64 ko 25 ke neeche likha. Answer 8908 aaya. Kya yeh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Line up from the right: ones under ones.

prompt.en: Teach Golu how to add 3407 + 85 without making a mistake.
prompt.hi: Golu ko sikhao 3407 + 85 bina galti ke kaise jodein.

challenges.hint: What should Golu do before adding?

prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! 600 − 250 = ?

prompt.en: A school collected 2,687 kg of paper in June and 1,458 kg in July. How many kilograms did it collect altogether?
prompt.hi: School ne June mein 2,687 kg aur July mein 1,458 kg paper collect kiya. Dono mahine milakar kitne kg paper hua?

challenges.hint: Line up ones under ones before adding.

prompt.en: A phone used 3,076 MB of data last week and 859 MB this week. How many MB did it use in total?
prompt.hi: Phone ne pichhle hafte 3,076 MB aur is hafte 859 MB data use kiya. Total kitna MB data use hua?

challenges.hint: Align digits by place value, then add from the ones.

prompt.en: Three classes collected 2,758, 3,687 and 946 used batteries for recycling. How many batteries did they collect altogether?
prompt.hi: Teen classes ne recycling ke liye 2,758, 3,687 aur 946 used batteries collect ki. Total kitni batteries hui?

challenges.hint: Add each place-value column, carrying when needed.

prompt.en: A metro card had ₹6,002. After several trips, ₹2,785 was spent. How much money remained?
prompt.hi: Metro card mein ₹6,002 the. Kuch trips par ₹2,785 kharch hue. Card mein kitne rupaye bache?

challenges.hint: Borrow across the zero columns from the thousands place.

prompt.en: Riya has ₹5,000 for a school event. She spends ₹1,785 on snacks and ₹2,468 on supplies. How much money is left?
prompt.hi: School event ke liye Riya ke paas ₹5,000 hain. Woh snacks par ₹1,785 aur supplies par ₹2,468 kharch karti hai. Kitne rupaye bache?

challenges.hint: Add both expenses, then subtract their total from the budget.

prompt.en: Teach Golu how to quickly check if ₹1000 is enough for things costing ₹420, ₹310 and ₹180.
prompt.hi: Golu ko sikhao jaldi se kaise check karein ki ₹420, ₹310 aur ₹180 ki cheezon ke liye ₹1000 kaafi hain ya nahi.

challenges.hint: Talk about rounding, adding, and comparing with the money.

prompt.en: Meera has ₹300 for a notebook costing ₹142 and a water bottle costing ₹126. Round each price to the nearest ₹10. Does her estimate say ₹300 is enough: yes or no?
prompt.hi: Meera ke paas ₹300 hain. Notebook ₹142 ki aur water bottle ₹126 ki hai. Dono prices nearest ₹10 par round karo. Estimate ke hisaab se ₹300 kaafi hain: haan ya nahin?

challenges.hint: Add the rounded prices, then compare with her money.

prompt.en: How many grams make 1 kg?
prompt.hi: Kitne gram milkar 1 kg bante hain?

challenges.hint: A kilo is a thousand grams.

prompt.en: 3 kg is how many grams?
prompt.hi: 3 kg kitne gram hain?

challenges.hint: Each kilo is 1000 g.

prompt.en: 2 kg 500 g is how many grams?
prompt.hi: 2 kg 500 g kitne gram hain?

challenges.hint: 2 kg is 2000 g; then add the 500 g.

prompt.en: Which is heavier: 1500 g or 2 kg?
prompt.hi: Kaun bhaari hai: 1500 g ya 2 kg?

challenges.hint: Are both in the same unit?

prompt.en: Biscuit packets weigh 200 g each. How many packets make 1 kg?
prompt.hi: Biscuit ke har packet ka wazan 200 g hai. Kitne packet milkar 1 kg bante hain?

challenges.hint: Count up in 200s until you reach 1000.

prompt.en: I said 4 kg = 400 g. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Maine kaha 4 kg = 400 g. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Each kg is 1000 g, not 100 g.

prompt.en: On a balance, one pan has a 1 kg weight. The other pan has two 200 g packets and one 500 g packet. Is it balanced? If not, which pan goes down?
prompt.hi: Taraazu ke ek palde mein 1 kg ka baat hai. Doosre mein 200 g ke do packet aur 500 g ka ek packet. Kya taraazu barabar hai? Agar nahi, toh kaunsa palda neeche jaayega?

challenges.hint: 200 + 200 + 500, compared with 1000 g.

prompt.en: A bag can carry 5 kg. Amma puts in 2 kg of rice, 1 kg 500 g of sugar and 750 g of dal. How much more can the bag carry?
prompt.hi: Ek thaila 5 kg tak utha sakta hai. Amma usme 2 kg chawal, 1 kg 500 g chini aur 750 g daal daalti hain. Thaila aur kitna utha sakta hai?

challenges.hint: Use grams for every item, then subtract their total from the limit.

prompt.en: Quick! Half a kilo is how many grams?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! Aadha kilo kitne gram hota hai?

challenges.hint: Half of 1000.

prompt.en: A cricket bat weighs 1 kg 300 g. What is its weight in grams?
prompt.hi: Ek cricket bat ka wazan 1 kg 300 g hai. Gram mein iska wazan kitna hai?

challenges.hint: Convert that part first, then add the remaining grams.

prompt.en: Two teams pack equipment for a kabaddi match. Team A's bag weighs 2 kg 80 g; Team B's weighs 2,180 g. Which is lighter: Team A or Team B?
prompt.hi: Kabaddi match ke liye Team A ka bag 2 kg 80 g hai; Team B ka 2,180 g. Kaunsi team ka bag halka hai: Team A ya Team B?

challenges.hint: Convert the mixed-unit weight into grams.

prompt.en: How many ml make 1 litre?
prompt.hi: Kitne ml milkar 1 litre banta hai?

challenges.hint: A litre is a thousand millilitres.

prompt.en: A jug holds 1 l of nimbu-pani. Each glass holds 200 ml. How many glasses can you fill?
prompt.hi: Ek jug mein 1 l nimbu-paani hai. Har glass mein 200 ml aata hai. Kitne glass bharenge?

challenges.hint: Count up in 200s until 1000.

prompt.en: 2 l is how many ml?
prompt.hi: 2 l kitne ml hain?

challenges.hint: Each litre is 1000 ml.

prompt.en: Which holds more: 3 bottles of 250 ml, or 1 bottle of 1 l?
prompt.hi: Kisme zyada aata hai: 250 ml ki 3 bottle, ya 1 l ki 1 bottle?

challenges.hint: 250 + 250 + 250, compared with 1000 ml.

prompt.en: A bucket holds 10 l. A mug holds 500 ml. How many mugs fill the bucket?
prompt.hi: Ek balti mein 10 l aata hai. Ek mug mein 500 ml. Balti bharne ke liye kitne mug lagenge?

challenges.hint: Two 500 ml mugs make 1 l.

prompt.en: I said 3 l = 300 ml. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Maine kaha 3 l = 300 ml. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Each litre is 1000 ml, not 100.

prompt.en: A measuring jug shows water at the 750 ml mark. Say this as a fraction of a litre.
prompt.hi: Ek measuring jug mein paani 750 ml ke nishaan tak hai. Ise litre ke fraction mein bolo.

challenges.hint: A quarter litre is 250 ml; 750 is three of those.

prompt.en: Bottle A holds 1 l 200 ml. Bottle B holds 1500 ml. Which holds more, and by how much?
prompt.hi: Bottle A mein 1 l 200 ml aata hai. Bottle B mein 1500 ml. Kisme zyada aata hai, aur kitna zyada?

challenges.hint: 1 l 200 ml is 1200 ml.

prompt.en: Quick! Half a litre is how many ml?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! Aadha litre kitne ml hai?

challenges.hint: Half of 1000.

prompt.en: A school canteen has 1 l 250 ml of lemonade in a dispenser. How many millilitres is that altogether?
prompt.hi: School canteen ke dispenser mein 1 l 250 ml lemonade hai. Yeh kul kitne millilitre hue?

challenges.hint: Change litres to millilitres, then add the remaining millilitres.

prompt.en: A steel jug holds 1 l 100 ml. A thermos holds 950 ml. Which holds more: the steel jug or the thermos?
prompt.hi: Steel jug mein 1 l 100 ml aata hai. Thermos mein 950 ml aata hai. Zyada kismein aata hai: steel jug ya thermos?

challenges.hint: Convert the mixed capacity to millilitres before comparing.

prompt.en: The school science lab receives 3 l 75 ml of liquid soap. Write the total amount in millilitres.
prompt.hi: School science lab ko 3 l 75 ml liquid soap mila. Kul quantity millilitre mein batao.

challenges.hint: Convert the litres first; keep the extra millilitres.

prompt.en: A train stall makes 3 l of lassi and keeps 500 ml aside. How many full 250 ml cups can it serve from the rest?
prompt.hi: Train stall 3 l lassi banata hai aur 500 ml alag rakhta hai. Bachi hui lassi se 250 ml ke kitne poore cups bhar sakte hain?

challenges.hint: Convert to millilitres, subtract, then count cupfuls.

prompt.en: Eggs come in trays of 6. How many eggs are in 3 trays?
prompt.hi: Ande 6-6 ki tray mein aate hain. 3 tray mein kitne ande hain?

challenges.hint: 3 trays of 6: count by 6s.

prompt.en: What is 7 × 8?
prompt.hi: 7 guna 8 kitna hota hai?

challenges.hint: 7 × 7 = 49; add one more 7.

prompt.en: What is 6 × 0?
prompt.hi: 6 guna 0 kitna hota hai?

challenges.hint: What is 6 groups of nothing?

prompt.en: If 3 × 8 = 24, what is 6 × 8?
prompt.hi: Agar 3 × 8 = 24 hai, toh 6 × 8 kitna hoga?

challenges.hint: 6 groups is double 3 groups.

prompt.en: I said 9 × 1 = 10 because multiplying always makes a number bigger. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Maine kaha 9 × 1 = 10, kyunki guna karne se number hamesha bada hota hai. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Think of keeping just one group of the original amount.

prompt.en: On a school trip there are 8 autos. Each auto carries 3 children and 1 teacher. How many people are there in all?
prompt.hi: School trip mein 8 auto hain. Har auto mein 3 bachche aur 1 teacher hain. Kul kitne log hain?

challenges.hint: 3 children + 1 teacher = 4 in each auto.

prompt.en: Quick! 9 × 6?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! 9 guna 6?

challenges.hint: 10 × 6 = 60; take away one 6.

prompt.en: At a school match, 7 kabaddi teams each have 6 players on court. How many players are on court altogether?
prompt.hi: School match mein 7 kabaddi teams hain. Har team ke 6 players court par hain. Kul kitne players court par hain?

challenges.hint: Use the multiplication fact for teams times players per team.

prompt.en: For a school event, 9 rows have 8 chairs each. After 5 chairs are taken away, how many chairs remain?
prompt.hi: School event mein 9 rows hain, har row mein 8 chairs. Phir 5 chairs hata di jaati hain. Kitni chairs bachti hain?

challenges.hint: Multiply the equal rows first, then subtract the removed chairs.

prompt.en: A game gives 6 points per win. Riya wins 4 rounds; Aman wins twice as many rounds. How many points does Aman earn?
prompt.hi: Ek game mein har win ke 6 points milte hain. Riya 4 rounds jeetti hai; Aman usse dugne rounds jeetta hai. Aman ko kitne points milte hain?

challenges.hint: Double the rounds first, then use points per win.

prompt.en: In a multiplication chart, the 7-row shows 7 × 6 = 42 and 7 × 7 = 49. Without starting the row again, what is 7 × 8?
prompt.hi: Multiplication chart ki 7 wali row mein 7 × 6 = 42 aur 7 × 7 = 49 hai. Row dobara shuru kiye bina, 7 × 8 kya hoga?

challenges.hint: Move one place right by adding the row's number.

prompt.en: Share 15 bananas equally among 3 monkeys. How many does each get?
prompt.hi: 15 kele 3 bandaron mein barabar baanto. Har ek ko kitne milenge?

challenges.hint: 3 groups of what make 15?

prompt.en: 48 ladoos are packed in boxes of 6. How many boxes?
prompt.hi: 48 laddoo 6-6 ke dabbon mein pack karne hain. Kitne dabbe lagenge?

challenges.hint: How many 6s make 48?

prompt.en: I divided 23 by 4 and wrote '4 groups and 7 left over'. Is that right?
prompt.hi: Maine 23 ko 4 se bhaag diya aur likha '4 group aur 7 bache'. Kya yeh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: The leftover must be less than 4.

prompt.en: Show 18 ÷ 3 on a number line: start at 18 and jump back by 3 until you reach 0. How many jumps?
prompt.hi: 18 ÷ 3 ko number line pe dikhao: 18 se shuru karke 3-3 peeche jump lagao jab tak 0 na aaye. Kitni jumps?

challenges.hint: 18, 15, 12, ... count every jump.

prompt.en: 30 people need to go by auto-rickshaw. Each auto takes 4 people. How many autos are needed so that everyone goes?
prompt.hi: 30 logon ko auto-rickshaw se jaana hai. Har auto mein 4 log baith sakte hain. Sabko le jaane ke liye kitne auto chahiye?

challenges.hint: Find the full autos, then check whether anyone remains.

prompt.en: Is 20 ÷ 4 the same as 4 ÷ 20?
prompt.hi: Kya 20 ÷ 4 aur 4 ÷ 20 same hain?

challenges.hint: 20 shared by 4, or 4 shared by 20: who gets more?

prompt.en: Quick! 35 ÷ 5?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! 35 ko 5 se bhaag do?

challenges.hint: Count by 5s to 35.

prompt.en: A school shares 36 quiz badges equally among 4 houses. How many badges does each house get?
prompt.hi: School 36 quiz badges 4 houses mein barabar baantta hai. Har house ko kitne badges milenge?

challenges.hint: Use a multiplication fact to check each share.

prompt.en: A badminton coach puts 56 shuttlecocks into tubes, with 7 in each tube. How many tubes are filled?
prompt.hi: Badminton coach 56 shuttlecocks tubes mein rakhta hai, har tube mein 7. Kitni tubes bharenगी?

challenges.hint: Think: how many groups of 7 make the total?

prompt.en: Eight friends share 96 game tokens equally. Each friend spends 5 tokens. How many tokens does each friend have left?
prompt.hi: 8 friends 96 game tokens barabar baantte hain. Har friend 5 tokens kharch karta hai. Har friend ke paas kitne tokens bachte hain?

challenges.hint: Share equally before subtracting what each spends.

prompt.en: For a school match, 104 water bottles are packed into crates of 8. How many full crates are packed?
prompt.hi: School match ke liye 104 water bottles, har crate mein 8, pack hoti hain. Kitne poore crates bharenge?

challenges.hint: Find the number that makes 8 times it equal 104.

prompt.en: Add 38 + 2 + 25 by making a friendly ten first.
prompt.hi: 38 + 2 + 25 jodo, pehle ek aasaan dahaai banake.

challenges.hint: 38 + 2 makes 40.

prompt.en: Work out 57 + 9 the quick way: add 10, then take away 1.
prompt.hi: 57 + 9 jaldi wale tareeke se karo: 10 jodo, phir 1 ghatao.

challenges.hint: 57 + 10 = 67; we added 1 too many.

prompt.en: Why is 63 − 28 the same as 65 − 30?
prompt.hi: 63 − 28 aur 65 − 30 ka answer same kyun hai?

challenges.hint: Both went up by 2.

prompt.en: Two children work out 74 + 19. Aman: 74 + 20 = 94, then 94 − 1 = 93. Bina: 74 + 20 = 94, then 94 + 1 = 95. Who is right?
prompt.hi: Do bachche 74 + 19 karte hain. Aman: 74 + 20 = 94, phir 94 − 1 = 93. Bina: 74 + 20 = 94, phir 94 + 1 = 95. Kaun sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Check how the result must change after using that larger number.

prompt.en: Use the same-difference trick for 82 − 39.
prompt.hi: 82 − 39 ko same-difference wali trick se karo.

challenges.hint: Add 1 to both: 83 − 40.

prompt.en: Fill the box: 7 + 5 = ☐ + 4. Golu wrote 12. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Box bharo: 7 + 5 = ☐ + 4. Golu ne 12 likha. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: The equals sign means both sides have the same value.

prompt.en: On a number line, show 46 + 25 as two jumps: one jump of 20 and one jump of 5. Where do you land?
prompt.hi: Number line pe 46 + 25 ko do jumps mein dikhao: ek 20 ki aur ek 5 ki. Kahan pahunchoge?

challenges.hint: 46 + 20 = 66, then a jump of 5.

prompt.en: In the 'reach 10' game, you and a friend take turns adding 1 or 2, starting from 0. Whoever says 10 wins. Which number should you say just before your friend's turn so that you surely win on your next turn?
prompt.hi: '10 tak pahuncho' khel mein tum aur dost baari-baari 1 ya 2 jodte ho, 0 se shuru. Jo 10 bole woh jeete. Dost ki baari se theek pehle tum kaunsa number bolo ki agli baari pakka jeet jao?

challenges.hint: From 8 or 9 you can reach 10; make your friend land on 8 or 9.

prompt.en: Quick! Work out 99 + 47 using a friendly number.
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! 99 + 47 ko ek aasaan number ki madad se karo.

challenges.hint: Add 100, then take away 1.

prompt.en: In a school-event addition chart, the row is 24 and the columns are 15 and 16. The entry for 24 + 15 is 39. What is the entry immediately to its right?
prompt.hi: School-event ke addition chart mein row 24 hai aur columns 15 aur 16 hain. 24 + 15 ki entry 39 hai. Uske turant right wali entry kya hogi?

challenges.hint: Keep the row number fixed as you move right.

prompt.en: A phone cover costs ₹48 and a charging cable costs ₹19. What is their total cost? Try using ₹20 as a friendly number.
prompt.hi: Ek phone cover ₹48 ka hai aur charging cable ₹19 ki. Dono ka total kitna hoga? ₹20 ko aasaan number ki tarah use karo.

challenges.hint: The round number counts one rupee extra.

prompt.en: In an addition chart for two cricket teams’ scores, the entry where row 47 meets column 28 is 75. What is the entry where row 48 meets column 29?
prompt.hi: Do cricket teams ke scores wale addition chart mein row 47 aur column 28 ki entry 75 hai. Row 48 aur column 29 ki entry kya hogi?

challenges.hint: Count the change from the row and the column.

prompt.en: A metro card has ₹203. A ride costs ₹98. How much money remains? Use a nearby round fare to calculate mentally.
prompt.hi: Metro card mein ₹203 hain. Ek ride ka kiraya ₹98 hai. Kitne paise bachenge? Mann mein hisaab karne ke liye paas ka round kiraya lo.

challenges.hint: Subtract the round fare, then correct for any extra subtraction.

prompt.en: In a ‘reach 10’ game, players take turns adding 1 or 2 to a running total. Whoever reaches 10 wins. The total is 6 and it is your turn. Should you add 1 or 2 to guarantee a win?
prompt.hi: ‘Reach 10’ game mein players baari-baari total mein 1 ya 2 jodte hain. Jo 10 tak pahunche, woh jeetega. Ab total 6 hai aur tumhari baari hai. Jeet pakki karne ke liye 1 jodoge ya 2?

prompt.en: In a tiger count table, Madhya Pradesh has 785 tigers and Karnataka has 563. Which has more?
prompt.hi: Bagh ginti ki table mein Madhya Pradesh mein 785 bagh hain aur Karnataka mein 563. Kisme zyada hain?

challenges.hint: Compare the counts from left to right.

prompt.en: How many more tigers does Madhya Pradesh (785) have than Karnataka (563)?
prompt.hi: Madhya Pradesh (785) mein Karnataka (563) se kitne zyada bagh hain?

challenges.hint: Find the gap: 785 − 563.

prompt.en: Uttarakhand has 560 tigers and Maharashtra has 444. How many fewer tigers does Maharashtra have?
prompt.hi: Uttarakhand mein 560 bagh hain aur Maharashtra mein 444. Maharashtra mein kitne kam bagh hain?

challenges.hint: Fewer also asks for the gap: bigger minus smaller.

prompt.en: A school has 1245 girls and 1180 boys. How many more girls than boys?
prompt.hi: Ek school mein 1245 ladkiyan aur 1180 ladke hain. Ladkon se kitni zyada ladkiyan hain?

challenges.hint: Find the gap: 1245 − 1180.

prompt.en: Question: how many more is 702 than 458? I worked column by column taking the smaller digit from the bigger: 8 − 2 = 6, 5 − 0 = 5, 7 − 4 = 3, so 356. Is that right?
prompt.hi: Sawaal: 702, 458 se kitna zyada hai? Maine har column mein bade digit mein se chhota ghataya: 8 − 2 = 6, 5 − 0 = 5, 7 − 4 = 3, toh 356. Kya yeh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Write 702 on top and take 458 away, borrowing where needed.

prompt.en: Show the comparison on a number line: start at 444 and jump to 785. How long is the jump?
prompt.hi: Number line pe comparison dikhao: 444 se 785 tak jump lagao. Jump kitni lambi hai?

prompt.en: A wildlife park had 1240 deer last year and 1385 this year. Did the number go up or down, and by how much?
prompt.hi: Ek wildlife park mein pichhle saal 1240 hiran the aur is saal 1385. Ginti badhi ya ghati, aur kitni?

challenges.hint: Compare the years, then subtract to find the change.

prompt.en: Quick! How many more is 900 than 650?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! 900, 650 se kitna zyada hai?

prompt.en: A school fair table shows tickets sold: Friday—online 1,246, counter 875; Saturday—online 1,508, counter 962. How many counter tickets were sold on Saturday?
prompt.hi: School fair ki table mein tickets bikey: Friday—online 1,246, counter 875; Saturday—online 1,508, counter 962. Saturday ko counter par kitne tickets bikey?

challenges.hint: Find the row for the day, then the correct column.

prompt.en: At a cricket match, 1,320 people entered through Gate A and 1,105 through Gate B. How many more people used Gate A?
prompt.hi: Cricket match mein Gate A se 1,320 aur Gate B se 1,105 log aaye. Gate A se kitne zyada log aaye?

challenges.hint: Find the gap by subtracting the smaller count.

prompt.en: A metro table lists riders: Monday—Blue 12,480, Green 10,905; Tuesday—Blue 11,760, Green 13,250. What is the Tuesday count for the Green Line?
prompt.hi: Metro table mein riders hain: Monday—Blue 12,480, Green 10,905; Tuesday—Blue 11,760, Green 13,250. Tuesday ko Green Line par kitne riders the?

challenges.hint: Use both the day row and the line column.

prompt.en: A school collected 4,205 kg of paper in July and 2,678 kg in August. How many more kilograms did it collect in July?
prompt.hi: School ne July mein 4,205 kg aur August mein 2,678 kg paper collect kiya. July mein kitne kg zyada collect hua?

challenges.hint: Subtract the smaller amount; you may need to regroup.

prompt.en: Three school teams scored 2,415, 2,154 and 2,451 points. What is the difference between the highest and second-highest scores?
prompt.hi: Teen school teams ne 2,415, 2,154 aur 2,451 points score kiye. Sabse zyada aur doosre sabse zyada score mein kitna fark hai?

challenges.hint: Compare place values, then subtract the top two scores.

prompt.en: Fold a paper heart down the middle. Do the two halves match exactly?
prompt.hi: Kaagaz ke dil ko beech se fold karo. Kya dono hisse bilkul mel khaate hain?

challenges.hint: If one half lies exactly on the other, the fold is a line of symmetry.

prompt.en: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
prompt.hi: Ek square mein symmetry ki kitni lines hoti hain?

challenges.hint: Also try folding corner to corner, both ways.

prompt.en: Does the letter A have a line of symmetry? Where is it?
prompt.hi: Kya letter A mein symmetry ki line hai? Kahan hai?

challenges.hint: The two slanting sides are mirror images.

prompt.en: Guess before folding: a rectangle of paper that is not a square, folded corner to corner. Will the two halves match exactly?
prompt.hi: Fold karne se pehle guess karo: ek rectangle kaagaz jo square nahi hai, corner se corner fold kiya. Kya dono hisse bilkul mel khayenge?

challenges.hint: Equal-sized parts must also lie exactly on each other.

prompt.en: How many lines of symmetry does a triangle with all sides equal have?
prompt.hi: Jis triangle ki teeno sides barabar hain, usmein symmetry ki kitni lines hain?

challenges.hint: The fold must reach the midpoint of the opposite side.

prompt.en: I said every shape has exactly one line of symmetry. Check me with a circle and with the letter S.
prompt.hi: Maine kaha har shape mein symmetry ki sirf ek line hoti hai. Ek circle aur letter S se mujhe check karo.

challenges.hint: Test folds through the round shape’s centre, then test the letter.

prompt.en: A triangular school pennant has two sides of 5 cm and a base of 6 cm. Fold it from the tip between the equal sides to the midpoint of the base. Will the halves match exactly?
prompt.hi: School ke triangular pennant ki do sides 5 cm aur base 6 cm hai. Barabar sides ke beech wale tip se base ke midpoint tak fold karo. Kya dono hisse bilkul match honge?

challenges.hint: Imagine where those equal sides go when folded.

prompt.en: A metro ticket is a 8 cm by 5 cm rectangle. How many lines can you fold it along so both halves match exactly?
prompt.hi: Ek metro ticket 8 cm by 5 cm ka rectangle hai. Use kitni lines par fold karne se dono hisse bilkul match honge?

challenges.hint: Check folds across its length and its width.

prompt.en: A board-game tile is a regular hexagon: all six sides and all six angles are equal. How many lines of symmetry does the tile have?
prompt.hi: Board game ki ek tile regular hexagon hai: uski sabhi chhe sides aur chhe angles barabar hain. Tile ki kitni symmetry lines hain?

challenges.hint: Also check folds through midpoints of opposite sides.

prompt.en: A school poster shows MOM in equally sized, upright block capital letters. Treat the whole word as one design. How many lines of symmetry does it have?
prompt.hi: School poster par MOM barabar size ke seedhe block capital letters mein likha hai. Poore word ko ek design maano. Iski kitni symmetry lines hain?

challenges.hint: Check whether the outer letters exchange places.

prompt.en: A dot is 2 squares to the left of a standing mirror line. Where does its mirror dot go?
prompt.hi: Ek dot khadi mirror line se 2 square left mein hai. Uska mirror dot kahan jaayega?

challenges.hint: The mirror dot is just as far on the other side.

prompt.en: An arrow points to the left, away from a standing mirror line. Guess: in the mirror half, which way will the arrow point?
prompt.hi: Ek arrow left ki taraf hai, khadi mirror line se door. Guess karo: mirror wale hisse mein arrow kis taraf hoga?

challenges.hint: When you look in a mirror and point away from it, which way does your reflection point?

prompt.en: A dot is 1 square to the left of the line. I drew its mirror 3 squares to the right. Is that right?
prompt.hi: Ek dot line se 1 square left mein hai. Maine uska mirror 3 square right mein banaya. Kya yeh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: The mirror dot is the same distance away.

prompt.en: A rangoli has a standing line and a lying line of symmetry. One diya is drawn in the top-left part. How many diyas will the complete rangoli have, and where?
prompt.hi: Ek rangoli mein symmetry ki ek khadi line aur ek leti line hai. Upar-left hisse mein ek diya bana hai. Poori rangoli mein kitne diye honge, aur kahan?

challenges.hint: Reflect across the standing line, then reflect both diyas across the lying line.

prompt.en: To complete a heart from its left half, Ravi copied the same half and slid it to the right without flipping it. Will it make a heart?
prompt.hi: Dil ka left wala aadha hissa poora karne ke liye Ravi ne wahi hissa copy karke bina palte right mein khiska diya. Kya dil banega?

challenges.hint: The right half must be its mirror image.

prompt.en: Meera completes a design across a standing mirror line by sliding its left half to the right without turning it. A diagonal stripe still slants the same way. Is her design symmetrical: yes or no?
prompt.hi: Meera design ka left half bina palte right side khiska deti hai. Dono tirchhi stripes ek hi taraf jhukti hain. Kya design symmetrical hai: haan ya nahin?

challenges.hint: Sliding keeps a slant unchanged; reflection reverses it.

prompt.en: On a grid, a dot is 5 squares left of a standing mirror line. Aarav puts its matching dot 3 squares right of the line, in the correct row. How many squares farther right must he move it?
prompt.hi: Grid par dot khadi mirror line se 5 squares left hai. Aarav matching dot ko sahi row mein 3 squares right rakhta hai. Use aur kitne squares right le jaana hoga?

challenges.hint: Matching dots need equal distances on opposite sides.

prompt.en: The minute hand points to 3. How many minutes past the hour is it?
prompt.hi: Minute ki sui 3 pe hai. Ghante ke baad kitne minute hue?

challenges.hint: Each number it moves past adds five minutes.

prompt.en: The hour hand is just past 7 and the minute hand points to 4. What time is it?
prompt.hi: Ghante ki sui 7 se thoda aage hai aur minute ki sui 4 pe. Kya time hua?

challenges.hint: The minute hand on 4 means 4 × 5 minutes.

prompt.en: The minute hand is on 5 and the hour hand is just past 10. I say it is 10:05. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Minute ki sui 5 pe hai aur ghante ki sui 10 se thoda aage. Main kehta hoon 10:05 hue. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Count by 5s up to the 5: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25.

prompt.en: At the school assembly, the clock’s hour hand is just past 8 and its minute hand points to 2. What time does the clock show?
prompt.hi: School assembly mein ghante ki sui 8 se thodi aage hai aur minute ki sui 2 par hai. Clock par kya time hai?

challenges.hint: Count five minutes for each number the minute hand has passed.

prompt.en: A badminton match starts at 4:25 in the afternoon. Write its start time using a.m. or p.m.
prompt.hi: Badminton match dopahar ke baad 4:25 par shuru hota hai. Start time a.m. ya p.m. ke saath likho.

challenges.hint: The letters tell us which half of the day it is.

prompt.en: A phone reminder says “12:00 p.m. — leave for lunch.” Why would changing it to 12:00 a.m. make the reminder wrong?
prompt.hi: Phone reminder mein likha hai ‘12:00 p.m. — lunch ke liye niklo.’ Ise 12:00 a.m. karne se reminder galat kyun hoga?

prompt.en: Cricket practice starts at 4:00 p.m. and ends at 6:00 p.m. How long is it?
prompt.hi: Cricket practice shaam 4:00 baje shuru hoti hai aur 6:00 baje khatam. Kitni der chali?

challenges.hint: 4 to 5 is one hour, 5 to 6 is another.

prompt.en: Way A: 2:10 − 1:50 = 60 minutes, by doing 210 − 150. Way B: from 1:50 to 2:00 is 10 minutes, and from 2:00 to 2:10 is 10 more, so 20 minutes. Which way is right?
prompt.hi: Tareeka A: 2:10 − 1:50 = 60 minute, 210 − 150 karke. Tareeka B: 1:50 se 2:00 tak 10 minute, aur 2:00 se 2:10 tak 10 aur, toh 20 minute. Kaunsa tareeka sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Count forward to the full hour, then to the end time.

prompt.en: Today is the 4th and my birthday is on the 11th. I counted 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and said 8 days to go. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Aaj 4 tareekh hai aur mera birthday 11 ko hai. Maine gina 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 aur kaha 8 din baaki hain. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Start counting from tomorrow, the 5th.

prompt.en: On a calendar, Monday is the 2nd. What is the date two Mondays later?
prompt.hi: Calendar pe Monday 2 tareekh ko hai. Do Monday baad kaunsi tareekh hogi?

challenges.hint: Each Monday later adds 7 days.

prompt.en: Suppose a Rajdhani train leaves Delhi at 4:55 p.m. and reaches the next morning at 8:55 a.m. How long is the journey?
prompt.hi: Maan lo ek Rajdhani train Delhi se 4:55 p.m. pe chalti hai aur agli subah 8:55 a.m. pe pahunchti hai. Safar kitni der ka hai?

challenges.hint: Split the journey at 4:55 a.m.

prompt.en: A school camp lasts 3 weeks and 2 days. How many days is that?
prompt.hi: Ek school camp 3 hafte aur 2 din chalta hai. Kitne din hue?

challenges.hint: 3 weeks is 3 × 7 days; then add 2.

prompt.en: The school library opens at 10:20 a.m. and closes at 11:00 a.m. How long is it open?
prompt.hi: School library subah 10:20 baje khulti hai aur 11:00 baje band hoti hai. Kitni der khuli rehti hai?

challenges.hint: Count forward from the start time, not backward from the end.

prompt.en: What is 23 × 10?
prompt.hi: 23 guna 10 kitna hota hai?

challenges.hint: Each digit moves one place to the left; a 0 fills the ones.

prompt.en: A train coach has 72 seats. How many seats are there in 10 coaches?
prompt.hi: Train ke ek coach mein 72 seat hain. 10 coach mein kitni seat hongi?

challenges.hint: 10 coaches of 72 is 72 × 10.

prompt.en: Each of 4 coaches has 23 seats. How many seats? Work out 23 × 4.
prompt.hi: 4 coach hain, har ek mein 23 seat. Kitni seat? 23 × 4 nikaalo.

challenges.hint: 20 × 4 and 3 × 4, then add.

prompt.en: For 27 × 3, Ram got 621 and Shyam got 81. Who is right?
prompt.hi: 27 × 3 ke liye Ram ka answer 621 aaya aur Shyam ka 81. Kaun sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Split 27 into tens and ones before multiplying.

prompt.en: A bus has 46 seats. How many seats are there in 5 buses?
prompt.hi: Ek bus mein 46 seat hain. 5 bus mein kitni seat hongi?

prompt.en: I said 45 × 10 = 55. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Maine kaha 45 × 10 = 55. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: × 10 means 10 groups, so each digit moves one place left.

prompt.en: The transport museum has 125 toy cars on each shelf. There are 6 shelves. How many toy cars are there?
prompt.hi: Transport museum mein har shelf pe 125 khilauna gaadiyaan hain. 6 shelf hain. Kul kitni gaadiyaan hain?

prompt.en: What is 214 × 3?
prompt.hi: 214 guna 3 kitna hoga?

challenges.hint: Multiply each part by 3.

prompt.en: Golu worked out 38 × 2 and wrote 316. Check his answer.
prompt.hi: Golu ne 38 × 2 kiya aur 316 likha. Uska answer check karo.

challenges.hint: Both the 30 and the 8 must be doubled.

prompt.en: Quick! 60 × 10?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! 60 guna 10?

challenges.hint: 6 tens times 10 is 6 hundreds.

prompt.en: A school orders 20 packs of badges. Each pack has 14 badges. How many badges does the school get?
prompt.hi: School ne badges ke 20 packs mangaye. Har pack mein 14 badges hain. School ko kul kitne badges milenge?

challenges.hint: Think of twenty packs as two groups of ten packs.

prompt.en: Three friends each save ₹32 for a school trip. How much do they save altogether?
prompt.hi: Teen dost school trip ke liye har ek ₹32 bachate hain. Ve kul kitne rupaye bachate hain?

challenges.hint: Multiply the tens and ones separately, then add.

prompt.en: A stadium sells 30 rows of tickets, with 45 tickets in each row. How many tickets are sold?
prompt.hi: Stadium mein tickets ki 30 rows biki hain. Har row mein 45 tickets hain. Kul kitni tickets biki?

challenges.hint: Thirty is three tens; multiply by three first.

prompt.en: Seven teams bring 68 water bottles each to a kabaddi event. How many bottles do they bring altogether?
prompt.hi: Kabaddi event mein saat teams har ek 68 paani ki bottles laati hain. Kul kitni bottles aati hain?

challenges.hint: Multiply the tens and ones by seven separately.

prompt.en: A game costs ₹236 per player. Four players register together and use a ₹1,000 note. How much change do they get?
prompt.hi: Ek game ki fee har player ke liye ₹236 hai. Chaar players saath register karte hain aur ₹1,000 ka note dete hain. Unhe kitne rupaye wapas milenge?

challenges.hint: Multiply the fee by four, then subtract from the note’s value.

prompt.en: 84 museum tickets are shared equally among 4 groups. How many tickets does each group get?
prompt.hi: 84 museum ticket 4 groupon mein barabar baante. Har group ko kitne ticket mile?

challenges.hint: 8 tens shared by 4 is 2 tens each; 4 ones shared by 4 is 1 each.

prompt.en: What is 72 ÷ 4?
prompt.hi: 72 ko 4 se bhaag do, kitna aaya?

challenges.hint: Each gets 1 ten, and 3 tens are left; change them into 30 ones.

prompt.en: Use repeated subtraction for 60 ÷ 5: first take away 10 fives (50), then more fives. How many fives in all?
prompt.hi: 60 ÷ 5 ko baar-baar ghataakar karo: pehle 10 paanch (50) ghatao, phir aur paanch. Kul kitne paanch?

challenges.hint: 60 − 50 = 10, and 10 is 2 more fives.

prompt.en: For 515 ÷ 5, Ana says 13 and Raj says 103. Who is right? Check by multiplying.
prompt.hi: 515 ÷ 5 ke liye Ana kehti hai 13 aur Raj kehta hai 103. Kaun sahi hai? Guna karke check karo.

challenges.hint: What is 13 × 5?

prompt.en: What is 348 ÷ 3?
prompt.hi: 348 ko 3 se bhaag do, kitna aaya?

challenges.hint: 3 hundreds ÷ 3 = 1 hundred; 4 tens ÷ 3 = 1 ten with 1 ten left; 18 ones ÷ 3 = 6.

prompt.en: Golu did 92 ÷ 4 like this: 9 ÷ 4 = 2, and 4 ÷ 2 = 2, so 22. Is that right?
prompt.hi: Golu ne 92 ÷ 4 aise kiya: 9 ÷ 4 = 2, aur 4 ÷ 2 = 2, toh 22. Kya yeh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: After 9 tens ÷ 4, 1 ten is left; it becomes 10 ones.

prompt.en: Show 45 ÷ 3 as an array with 3 rows. How many are in each row?
prompt.hi: 45 ÷ 3 ko 3 rows wale array se dikhao. Har row mein kitne honge?

challenges.hint: Split 45 into parts that are easy to share across three rows.

prompt.en: 130 children go to the transport museum in vans. Each van takes 8 children. How many vans are needed?
prompt.hi: 130 bachche van se transport museum jaate hain. Har van mein 8 bachche baithte hain. Kitni van chahiye?

challenges.hint: Find full groups of 8, then check the remainder.

prompt.en: A 75 m rope is cut into pieces of 5 m. How many pieces?
prompt.hi: 75 m ki rassi ke 5-5 m ke tukde kiye. Kitne tukde bane?

challenges.hint: 50 m gives 10 pieces, then 25 m gives 5 more.

prompt.en: Teach Golu how to divide 256 by 2, and how to check the answer.
prompt.hi: Golu ko sikhao 256 ko 2 se kaise bhaag dein, aur answer kaise check karein.

challenges.hint: Talk about the leftover ten and checking by multiplying.

prompt.en: Quick! 69 ÷ 3?
prompt.hi: Jaldi batao! 69 ko 3 se bhaag do?

challenges.hint: 2 tens each, then 9 ones ÷ 3 = 3.

prompt.en: A school packs 68 badges equally into 4 boxes. How many badges go in each box?
prompt.hi: School mein 68 badges ko 4 boxes mein barabar rakha. Har box mein kitne badges honge?

challenges.hint: Exchange a ten for ones if some tens remain.

prompt.en: A phone has 75 MB of data left. Each video uses 3 MB. How many videos can be watched?
prompt.hi: Phone mein 75 MB data bacha hai. Har video 3 MB leti hai. Kitni videos dekhi ja sakti hain?

challenges.hint: Take away a large batch of videos’ data first.

prompt.en: A cricket club has 144 practice balls. It puts 6 balls in each kit. Taking away large batches of 6 first, how many full kits can it make?
prompt.hi: Cricket club ke paas 144 practice balls hain. Har kit mein 6 balls rakhta hai. Pehle 6 ke bade batches ghataakar, kitni poori kits banengi?

challenges.hint: Subtract that batch’s balls, then group what remains.

prompt.en: For a school trip, 235 students need seats in autos that hold 9 students each. What is the least number of autos needed?
prompt.hi: School trip ke liye 235 students ko autos mein jaana hai. Har auto mein 9 students baithte hain. Kam se kam kitne autos chahiye?

challenges.hint: Divide first, then check whether anyone is left.

prompt.en: Tally marks show two full bundles of five and 3 single lines. How many is that?
prompt.hi: Tally marks mein paanch-paanch ke do poore bundle aur 3 akeli lines hain. Kul kitne hue?

challenges.hint: Two bundles of 5 and 3 more.

prompt.en: Key: 1 star = 100 people. A village's row shows 7 stars. How many people?
prompt.hi: Key: 1 star = 100 log. Ek gaon ki row mein 7 star hain. Kitne log?

challenges.hint: Count by 100s for each star.

prompt.en: Ravi read a full tally bundle as 4 because he counted only the standing lines. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Ravi ne ek poore tally bundle ko 4 padha kyunki usne sirf khadi lines gini. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: The crossing line is a tally mark too.

prompt.en: In a bar graph of votes for class monitor, Asha's bar reaches the 12 line. How many votes did she get?
prompt.hi: Class monitor ke votes ke bar graph mein Asha ka bar 12 ki line tak pahunchta hai. Use kitne vote mile?

challenges.hint: Read the number on the scale level with the top of the bar.

prompt.en: Asha got 12 votes and Bilal got 8. How many more votes did Asha get?
prompt.hi: Asha ko 12 vote mile aur Bilal ko 8. Asha ko kitne zyada vote mile?

challenges.hint: Find the gap between the two bars.

prompt.en: The scale goes 0, 10, 20, 30, 40. A bar for mangoes sold stops halfway between 20 and 30. How many mangoes?
prompt.hi: Scale 0, 10, 20, 30, 40 hai. Bike aamon ka bar 20 aur 30 ke theek beech mein rukta hai. Kitne aam?

challenges.hint: Find half the gap between those marks.

prompt.en: The scale goes up in steps of 5. Bilal's bar is 4 squares tall. I said Bilal got 4 votes. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Scale 5-5 ke steps mein badhta hai. Bilal ka bar 4 square ooncha hai. Maine kaha Bilal ko 4 vote mile. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Each square is a step of 5.

prompt.en: Asha got 12 votes, Bilal 8, Chitra 15 and Dev 5. How many children voted in all?
prompt.hi: Asha ko 12 vote, Bilal ko 8, Chitra ko 15 aur Dev ko 5. Kul kitne bachchon ne vote diya?

challenges.hint: Add all four bars.

prompt.en: A school canteen bar graph uses the scale 0, 5, 10, 15. The idli bar reaches 10 and the samosa bar reaches 15. How many more samosas than idlis were sold?
prompt.hi: School canteen ke bar graph ka scale 0, 5, 10, 15 hai. Idli ka bar 10 tak aur samose ka bar 15 tak pahunchta hai. Idli se kitne zyada samose bike?

challenges.hint: Find the difference between the two bar values.

prompt.en: A bar graph of kabaddi points has marks 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75. Team Jaipur’s bar reaches 75; Team Pune’s reaches 45. How many more points did Jaipur score?
prompt.hi: Kabaddi points ke bar graph mein marks 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75 hain. Team Jaipur ka bar 75 aur Team Pune ka 45 tak pahunchta hai. Jaipur ne kitne zyada points banaye?

challenges.hint: Subtract the lower bar value from the higher one.

prompt.en: A metro-station bar graph shows bicycles parked. Its scale is 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50. The Friday bar ends halfway between 30 and 40. The Saturday bar reaches 50. How many more bicycles were parked on Saturday?
prompt.hi: Metro station par park hui bicycles ke bar graph ka scale 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 hai. Friday ka bar 30 aur 40 ke beech aadhe par rukta hai. Saturday ka bar 50 tak hai. Saturday ko kitni zyada bicycles park hui?

challenges.hint: First read Friday’s bar, then compare it with Saturday’s.
